Mozilla Readability 0.6.0 (Apache-2.0), unmodified, from
https://registry.npmjs.org/@mozilla/readability/-/readability-0.6.0.tgz — the engine behind
Firefox Reader View. Used by the Safari extension to drop page clutter before the text
reaches the model. `../make-page-js.sh` bundles it into `../RetAInPage.js`.
